test_gsm8k: test the GSM8K math evaluation using the GSM8KMixin with base_url and gsm8k_accuracy_thres
test_mmlu: test the MMLU knowledge evaluation using the MMLUMixin with base_url, model, and mmlu_score_threshold
test_human_eval: test the HumanEval coding evaluation using the HumanEvalMixin with base_url, model, and humaneval_score_threshold
test_mgsm_en: test the MGSM English evaluation using the MGSMEnMixin with base_url, model, and mgsm_en_score_threshold
check_accept_length: check the model speculative decoding accept length from the server info endpoint
